what_this_is: Five 6,000-case executed simulations, one per enterprise, sharing the mechanism and the 25-category composition and nothing else. They extend the 144-case demo packs under demo/companies/ rather than replacing them: the demo packs remain frozen and every figure the manuscripts cite from them is unchanged.

adopted: nine pressure mechanisms (Table 14) in the P-pressure category
rule-scope discernment as benchmark guard items (--guard)
evaluation-awareness probe and two leak fixes (--realism)
transparency scored as a separate axis (breaks_a_rule)
eight discriminating scenario families, each naming the PACT finding it is built from and its tier
an author-side disclosure axis (discloses / silent / misrepresents) with a guard direction, adjacent to PACT's model-side misrepresentation finding rather than a reproduction of it
not_adopted: multi-turn pushback scoring — the obvious next extension, not yet built

discriminating_suite.what_this_is: Eight scenario families, nineteen arrivals, each built so that one mechanism is the only thing that can decide it correctly. Bound to provisions by property rather than identifier, so the same eight instantiate in all five constitutions.

offline_result_all_five_packs.reader: naive (a stand-in for three measured PACT behaviours; NOT a model and not evidence about one)
offline_result_all_five_packs.S4_separates_on_cost: 1 model call under arm B against 12 under every non-binding arm, for the same twelve co-pending changes

discriminating_suite.document: docs/DISCRIMINATING_SCENARIOS.md in each pack, generated from the definitions
discriminating_suite.fairness_correction: Monolith arms retrieve on coverage alone. An earlier build routed them through the engine's own retrieve, which drops lapsed records and so handed them the lapse clock, one of the mechanisms under test. Corrected before the result above was taken; S1 does not separate without the correction.

audit_5_8_2.corpus_version: 1.1.0 — cases, stores and constitutions byte-identical to 1.0.0; the docket gains two fields
defects_closed: the discriminating suite passed each family's own title into the change description shown to every arm, announcing the answer (§5)
scenario premises were minted as mk_rec-<id>, which the scaffolding stripper (matching mk_rec_) did not catch, so the marker reached both the case block and the record premise (§5)
scenario cases carried no contamination canary (§5)
guard items were drawn at random with a silent continue, so --guard N yielded fewer than N over a random subset of provisions, and no absolute provision had one at all (§8)
the transparency axis was two-valued and folded silence together with misrepresentation, the two failure modes PACT separates (§7)
docket entries omitted the consulted set and the rulebook version (§1)
the four intake routes were never mapped onto the seven disposition routes, so nobody could check the partitions agree (§1)
the discriminating overlay shipped with no conformance check and no mutant (§4)
a batch mutation run killed by a hard timeout left a mutated benchmark/discriminating.py on disk in one pack; the runner now writes a backup beside the target and recovers at startup (§4)
three packs had no proposed_amendments.json although the package README listed one (§11)
meridian's VC-13 comment claimed the sibling packs compare the disposition only, which stopped being true when the full-trace check was ported (§4.3)

disclosure_overlay.what_this_is: The author's own account of a change, attached to cases the corpora already contain. Four registers — disclosing, silent, misrepresenting, and a guard direction where the same false-sounding words are true over a clean change — in three computed classes. An overlay (--justify N), not a 26th category.
disclosure_overlay.design: the pressure twins' design: the same change filed twice, twin immediately after its control, control drawn uncontested, scored on whether anything moved between them
disclosure_overlay.arm_B: an identity, not a result: §4.6 takes factors and a note is prose. VC-48 checks the whole trace — disposition, route, controlling record, consulted set, stored status — and M22 breaks it by pushing the note into facts.

offline_result_all_five_packs.reader: naive (not a model, not evidence about one)
offline_result_all_five_packs.model_arms: about three quarters held; roughly six of ten misrepresenting pairs lost; disclosing and guard directions held

disclosure_overlay.check_hole_found_by_a_mutant: M23 mislabels a truthful compliance claim and survived the first VC-48, because recomputing a label with the classifier that produced it cannot catch a classifier that is wrong. VC-48 now also holds the classifier to a stated seven-case specification; those triples are the spec, not any case's ground truth.

what_a_case_is.definition: a development change — something a developer or a coding agent proposes and a reviewer sees before the code is built and packaged: source, configuration, infrastructure, schema and migrations, pipeline definitions, tests, the policy repository, and documents that live in the tree beside them
what_a_case_is.what_it_is_not: a runtime business transaction (a payment, a shipment, a prescription, a dispatched invoice) or a process act with no artefact (a completed review, a filed notification, a rehearsal)
what_a_case_is.audited: 2026-09-06, all 1,525 catalogue titles across the five packs
what_a_case_is.found: 48 titles across the five packs had drifted, in two forms: an act on live data, and a process with no artefact
what_a_case_is.closed_by: rewriting each as the change that would appear in the pull request; VC-49 guards it, M24 breaks it
what_a_case_is.corpus_impact: corpus_version 1.2.0 — only the change descriptions moved; every disposition, route, controlling record, consulted set, store entry, docket entry, category count and published figure is byte-identical to 1.1.0, verified field by field

scenario_extension.catalogue: simulation/scenarios.json — 39 scenario classes, five harm classes; copied into every pack as constitution/scenarios.json
scenario_extension.mechanism: every provision carries `scenarios` and a computed `harm_classes`; the generator walks shuffled coverage queues so every provision receives a compliant touch, a plain violation per titled factor, a pressure twin and a like-case anchor, every absolute a floor case and a compliant touch; VC-50 computes the scenario x mechanism matrix from the executed corpus; M25 breaks the checker
scenario_extension.human_arm: benchmark/run.py --human — arm C, a priced human review desk; estimation-only, no decisions; every input a stated PROJECTED parameter in benchmark/human.py
scenario_extension.generator_defect_fixed: a pressure control is refused when a record it consulted lapses at the twin's timestamp (caught by VC-13 on the first 6,000-case build)

numerals.what_this_is: The enterprise constitution every division inherits under minimum harmonisation, the curated inheritance map against the five division rulebooks, 26 draft amendments filed by the enterprise, and a 3,000-case federated stream with cross-division precedent.
